reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issue 'google-service-gateway: move to swift-crypto 5.x' (no URL or number given)
reviewContext.userProblem: Every Swift package in the Riela dependency graph must require and build against apple/swift-crypto 5.x so Riela can resolve a single 5.x version. This repository requires swift-crypto from 4.5.1 and Package.resolved pins 4.5.1 (revision 47d3869a7291f085c1fb9fb1e6d3b97a793f45c6).
requiredOutcomes: Package.resolved pins swift-crypto 5.0.3 or a later 5.x via `swift package update swift-crypto`; only the swift-crypto pin, the swift-asn1 pin if required, and originHash change.
Any swift-crypto 5 compile error or deprecation is fixed with no behavior change; the PKCE S256 challenge stays byte-for-byte identical.
VERSION and Version.current are bumped from 0.1.6 to 0.1.7 in the final commit.
swift build, swift test, mise run build, mise run test and mise run lint pass.
Changes are committed and pushed to main.
nonGoals: Publishing GitHub releases, tags, Homebrew formulas or casks.
Updating any dependency other than swift-crypto (and swift-asn1 only if swift-crypto 5 requires it); no bare `swift package update`.
Refactoring the PKCE code, replacing CryptoKit on Darwin, or changing the Linux-only Crypto product condition.
constraints: If any dependency caps swift-crypto below 5, report a blocker with the exact constraint instead of working around it.
swift-tools-version 6.0, .macOS(.v14) and swiftLanguageModes [.v6] stay; if swift-crypto 5 requires a change, report a blocker instead of editing.
Package.resolved is written only by SwiftPM, never hand-edited.
Any OAuthClient.swift edit stays inside the existing #if canImport(CryptoKit) boundary and leaves the CryptoKit branch untouched.
Workers never revert, restore, checkout or stash files outside their own writePaths, including the pre-existing design-docs/specs/architecture.md edit.
Build and test exit codes are recorded from the swift command itself (redirect to log, then echo exit=$?), never through tee.
Swift files stay under 1000 lines; swiftlint runs on changed Swift files.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Use from: "5.0.3" (not exact or upToNextMinor) so Riela can unify on any 5.x release.
Use the targeted `swift package update swift-crypto` so unrelated pins do not move.
Keep CryptoKit on Darwin and Crypto only on Linux, because the only crypto use is SHA256 for PKCE and the existing split already isolates swift-crypto to Linux.
Version lives in exactly VERSION and Sources/GoogleServiceGatewayCore/Version.swift (precedent commit a30eb3d); tests compare against Version.current so no test edit is needed.
Two disjoint wave-1 plans; authoritative build/test/lint gates run once in serial reconciliation before the single commit and push.
intentionalTradeoffs: Plan-local swift build/test runs in PLAN-SC5-DEPS may observe concurrent VERSION/Version.swift edits; they are evidence only, and reconciliation gates are authoritative.
The Linux `import Crypto` path may remain uncompiled locally; it is recorded as a verification gap rather than installing a toolchain.
supportedEdgeCases: swift-crypto 5 requires a newer swift-asn1: the swift-asn1 pin may move via SwiftPM.
swift-crypto 5 breaks the Linux SHA256.hash path: a minimal edit inside the non-CryptoKit branch preserving SHA-256 then base64url-without-padding bytes.
Resolution conflict or tools/platform requirement beyond 6.0/macOS 14: reported as a blocker with the SwiftPM error text.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Working around a dependency cap below swift-crypto 5 with forks, overrides or exact pins.
Raising tools version, platform minimum or language mode.

acceptanceCriteria: Package.resolved pins swift-crypto at 5.0.3 or a later 5.x; only the swift-crypto pin, swift-asn1 pin (if required) and originHash changed; google-gateway-auth pin unchanged.
OAuthClient.swift unchanged unless swift-crypto 5 breaks the Linux Crypto path; any edit preserves PKCE challenge bytes.
swift build and swift test print exit=0 with full logs at tmp/sc5-build.log and tmp/sc5-test.log.
Progress Log records resolved swift-crypto and swift-asn1 versions, swift-crypto 5 manifest requirements, Linux verification result or gap, and exit codes.
verification: mkdir -p tmp && swift build > tmp/sc5-build.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"

acceptanceCriteria: VERSION contains exactly 0.1.7 with one trailing newline.
Version.swift line 2 reads `  public static let current = "0.1.7"`.
grep -rn '0\.1\.6' VERSION Sources returns no matches.
git diff --name-only -- VERSION Sources/GoogleServiceGatewayCore/Version.swift lists exactly those two files.

reconciliation.commitAndPush: One commit on main after all gates pass, then push to origin main. No GitHub release or Homebrew publication.
